title: Metric-Free Riemannian Optimization
summary: Riemannian optimization provides a powerful framework for constrained optimization by incorporating problem-specific structure directly into the geometry of the search space. In many applications, however, the explicit evaluation or application of the Riemannian metric can be computationally expensive or numerically unstable, limiting the practical efficiency of otherwise well-founded algorithms.
